necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for undiagnosed paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential embolic source. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. This study aims to guide anticoagulation therapy and rate control management based on the burden of atrial fibrillation detected.
